children: OFCOM  - OFCOM SETS OUT FINAL DECISIONS ON OPENREACH OFFERS
OFCOM: OPENREACH MUST GIVE OFCOM AND BROADER INDUSTRY ADVANCE NOTICE BEFORE IT INTRODUCES CERTAIN TYPES OF COMMERCIAL OFFERS.
OFCOM: CONFIRMING THAT WE ARE INTERVENING TO DIRECT OPENREACH TO WITHDRAW ITS 'INCREMENTAL NEW TO OPENREACH' OFFER
OFCOM: WE CONSIDER 'INCREMENTAL NEW TO OPENREACH' OFFER WOULD BE UNFAIR AND COULD HARM SUSTAINABLE COMPETITION
OFCOM: SEPARATELY, OPENREACH ALSO NOTIFIED US OF SEVERAL OTHER COMMERCIAL OFFERS IT INTENDS TO INTRODUCE
